title: HR Administrator
description:
Are you an experienced Administrator? We are working with a company in South Leeds who are looking to take on an Administrator on an ongoing temporary basis to support the HR function. This fully office based role with office hours of 9-5 will require the successful candidate to support the HR and Payroll Manager with all administrative duties to support the wider team. Duties will vary but having a proactive, can do mindset is key, day to day tasks will include:
- Supporting the HR Manager with all administrative support
- Managing the on-boarding process for all new starters
- Chasing all RTW documents
- Inputting time-sheet and payroll information
- Manual & electronic filing
- General administrative support

This is a fantastic role for a candidate with 6-12 months administration experience, a long term role. This is a great opportunity to join a respected organisation where you will be given responsibility and exposure to many areas of the business. The successful administrator will have;
- A minimum of 6 months administration experience
- Excellent communication skills- both written and verbal
- Strong attention to detail
- A confident team player
- Proficiency in all MS Office packages

If you are available immediately and can commit to this ongoing, temporary role, please send your CV for immediate review.

title: HR and Compliance Administrator
description:
We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented HR and Compliance Administrator to support both the HR and Compliance functions of the business. This varied role will involve coordinating the employee lifecycle from onboarding through to leavers, maintaining accurate HR records, supporting payroll administration, and ensuring compliance with internal procedures and external funding and audit requirements.

This position would suit an experienced administrator with excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. Previous HR administration experience would be advantageous but is not essential, as full training can be provided for the right individual.

Leeds City Centre (LS1), 28,000 per annum, Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm

This is a fully office-based position.

Key Responsibilities
HR Administration
- Coordinate the onboarding process for new employees, ensuring all documentation is completed accurately and within required timescales.
- Process employment references and right to work documentation.
- Arrange and monitor DBS checks where required.
- Prepare contracts of employment, contract amendments and change of terms documentation.
- Administer probation review processes and maintain accurate employee records.
- Process employee leavers and ensure all relevant documentation is completed.
- Collate payroll information including starters, leavers, contractual changes, sickness, holiday and payroll amendments for submission within deadlines.
- Maintain confidential employee files and HR databases, ensuring compliance with GDPR.
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the HR team.

Compliance and Administration
- Validate documentation and records to ensure compliance with internal procedures and external funding requirements.
- Perform eligibility and compliance checks where required.
- Accurately enter and maintain information on internal management information systems.
- Create and maintain tracking spreadsheets, databases and compliance records.
- Prepare documentation and records for audits, inspections and quality assurance processes.
- Carry out regular compliance audits and identify any discrepancies or missing documentation.
- Register learners or employees on relevant external systems where applicable and ensure all deadlines are met.
- Maintain procedures, templates and administrative documentation.
- Support external audits, inspections and verification visits, ensuring documentation is accurate and readily available.
- Ensure compliance with organisational policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.
- Assist with continuous improvement of administrative and compliance processes.
- Undertake any other administrative duties required to support the wider business.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience
Essential
- Minimum of two years' experience within an administrative or compliance-based role.
- Excellent organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to prioritise workload and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
- Strong IT skills including Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Experience maintaining confidential records with a high level of accuracy.
- GCSE Grade 4/C or above (or equivalent) in English and Maths.

Desirable
- Previous HR administration experience including onboarding, contracts and payroll administration.
- Experience arranging DBS checks and maintaining personnel records.
- Experience working within a regulated or compliance-driven environment.
- Knowledge of audit processes and quality assurance requirements.
- Experience using HR or management information systems.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Personal Attributes
- Highly organised and methodical.
- Professional with excellent attention to detail.
- Able to maintain confidentiality at all times.
- Positive, proactive and willing to support colleagues.
- Strong team player with the ability to build effective working relationships.
- Flexible approach with a willingness to learn new systems and processes.

What We're Looking For

This role would suit someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced administrative environment where accuracy and organisation are essential. Whether your background is in HR administration, compliance, education administration or general business support, you'll be someone who takes pride in producing high-quality work, enjoys working with processes and systems, and is committed to maintaining high standards of compliance across the business.

Huntress Search Ltd acts as a Recruitment Agency in relation to all Permanent roles and as a Recruitment Business in relation to all Temporary roles.

We practice a diverse and inclusive recruitment process that ensures equal opportunity for all we work with, irrespective of race, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, age or gender. As an organisation, we encourage applications from all backgrounds and will ensure measures are met when required, to allow a fair process throughout.

PLEASE NOTE: We can only consider applications from candidates who have the right to work in the UK.

title: HR Assistant
description:
Sewell Wallis is delighted to be working with a leading global professional services organisation in Leeds, West Yorkshire, that is looking to recruit an HR Assistant to join their busy and collaborative HR team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced HR Administrator or HR Assistant looking for their next step within a well-established, forward-thinking business. You'll be joining a fast-paced team where you'll gain exposure to a wide variety of HR processes and have the opportunity to develop your skills and career.

What will you be doing?

This is a varied HR role supporting the full employee life-cycle, with a particular focus on HR administration and ensuring processes are completed accurately and within deadlines.

You'll be responsible for:
- Managing the full on-boarding process for new starters, including right to work checks, issuing offers and contracts, completing on-boarding activities and setting up employee records.
- Managing the off-boarding process for leavers and ensuring everything is completed within payroll deadlines.
- Processing changes to terms and conditions, including preparing letters and communicating changes to employees.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date employee information on the HR system.
- Processing changes such as cost centre moves, reporting line changes and contractual amendments.
- Responding to day-to-day HR queries, including maternity, paternity and flexible working.
- Supporting the wider HR team with projects and process improvement initiatives.
- Providing general HR team support, including preparing PowerPoint presentations, taking meeting notes and assisting with day-to-day activities.
- Ensuring all HR administration is completed accurately, efficiently and confidentially.

What skills are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who has previous experience working within an HR Administrator or HR Assistant role and is keen to continue developing their career within HR.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience within HR administration or HR support.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- An understanding of UK Right to Work requirements.
- Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a high-volume workload.
- The confidence to work independently and take ownership of your workload.
- Experience using HR systems - Workday experience would be advantageous.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A proactive, adaptable and positive approach.
- The ability to work well as part of a busy and collaborative team.

What's on offer?
- 25,000 - 30,000 salary
- Hybrid working + Benefits package
- The opportunity to join a global and highly respected organisation
- A supportive and collaborative HR team
- A varied role with exposure to the full employee life-cycle
- Excellent opportunity for career development and progression

If you're an HR Administrator or HR Assistant looking for a new opportunity with a business that can offer variety, development and hybrid working, this could be a great next step for you.

To apply, please apply below or contact Jemima for more information.

To apply please send your CV, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications please accept that if we have not responded to your application within seven days, your application has not been successful. Sewell Wallis is a specialist recruitment company with a vast amount of experience in our industry we offer permanent, temporary and interim recruitment support for accounting and finance, human resources and business support positions. We recruit at all levels within finance from Purchase Ledger Administrator and Credit Controller level through to Financial Controller and Director positions. With offices in Sheffield and Leeds, we are well situated to cover all of South Yorkshire, West Yorkshire and Manchester. Please visit our website for more information on accountancy and finance jobs and human resources or business support positions.

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Recruitment Administrator

Location: Leeds
Salary: 27,500 - 28,000 per annum
Job Type: Full-time, Office Based

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly organised Recruitment Administrator to join our busy Leeds team.

This is a varied, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You'll be supporting the recruitment team with candidate onboarding, pre-employment checks and general administration, ensuring everything is completed accurately and on time.

We're looking for someone who is naturally organised, enjoys working with people and can confidently manage multiple tasks and priorities.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing the candidate onboarding process from registration through to placement
- Completing pre-employment and compliance checks
- Checking and maintaining candidate documentation
- Carrying out right-to-work and identification checks
- Updating internal systems and databases
- Managing candidate records and ensuring information is accurate and up to date
- Supporting recruiters with day-to-day administration
- Communicating with candidates and clients professionally
- Responding to emails and queries promptly
- Managing multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
- General office administration and recruitment support

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Enthusiastic, positive and motivated
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- A confident communicator with a good telephone manner
- Friendly, approachable and professional
- Able to multi-task and prioritise in a busy environment
- Comfortable working to deadlines and targets
- IT literate and confident using Microsoft Office and computer systems
- Reliable, proactive and able to use their own initiative
- A strong team player who enjoys working in a busy office environment

Previous recruitment or administration experience would be beneficial, but attitude, organisation and a willingness to learn are equally important.

What We Offer
- 27,500 - 28,000 salary
- Leeds-based office role
- Temp to Perm
- Monday-Friday, office based
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Varied and interesting role
- Opportunity to develop your career within recruitment

Interested?

If you are an organised, enthusiastic administrator who enjoys working with people and wants to build a career within recruitment, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV!
